sourceText.he: וְאֵינוֹ נוֹהֵג בָּעוֹף. וְהָא קָא חָזֵינַן דְּאִית לֵיהּ? אִית לֵיהּ, וְלָא עֲגִיל.

positions.claim: the prohibition of the sciatic nerve does not apply to a bird
positions.basis: the verse speaks of the nerve 'upon the spoon of the thigh' (Genesis 32:33) — the verse is supplied by the Steinsaltz elucidation, not by the quoted Talmud text

positions.claim: a bird's thigh protrusion is not rounded and therefore is not a 'spoon'
